page: Running Hono on Next.js React framework with Node.js runtime. Deploy to Vercel with Vercel Functions. App Router (recommended): app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts with handle() from hono/vercel. Basepath /api for API routes. Export GET, POST, etc. methods. Full-stack with React UIs. Run: npm run dev, access http://localhost:3000. Deploy: Vercel Git integration (link repository). Pages Router (legacy): pages/api/[[...route]].ts with @hono/node-server getRequestListener(), basePath /api. Requires: bodyParser: false config, NODEJS_HELPERS=0 environment variable. sections.manifest: Next.js setup with Hono. Create: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nextjs template (yarn, pnpm, bun, deno variants). Install: npm i. Project structure ready. Questions: How do I create project? Which template?

Hello World with App Router (recommended). File: app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts. Imports: Hono, handle from 'hono/vercel'. Code: new Hono().basePath('/api'), app.get('/hello', ...), export const GET = handle(app), export const POST = handle(app). Supports HTTP methods: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc. Access: /api/hello. Combine with React UIs for full-stack. Questions: What's the entry file? How do I export handlers? What's basePath?

Development and local access. Command: npm run dev, yarn dev, pnpm dev, bun run dev. Access: http://localhost:3000. Route example: /api/hello returns JSON. Questions: How do I run locally? What URL? How do I test?
Deployment to Vercel. Method: Git integration (link repository to Vercel). Dashboard config. Simple deployment flow. Questions: How do I deploy? What's needed?

Pages Router (legacy alternative). Install: @hono/node-server. File: pages/api/[[...route]].ts. Import: getRequestListener from @hono/node-server. Config: api.bodyParser = false in PageConfig. Code: new Hono().basePath('/api'), export default getRequestListener(app.fetch). Environment: set NODEJS_HELPERS=0 in .env or Vercel dashboard. Disables Vercel Node.js helpers. Questions: When use Pages Router? What's the setup? Why disable helpers? What's getRequestListener?
